Handed to the team · Warehouse has not allocated stock to the shipment; only a person can push the WR

Hi Eric,

You have every reason to be in a bad mood. You have been waiting about two months for a power supply, and I'm sorry. Telling you "end of this week" and then going quiet again is exactly what should not have happened.

Here is where it actually stands today. The warehouse still has not booked that stock onto your shipment for Shop····. Your order is sitting on hold waiting for stock, and there is no tracking number yet. That's why nothing more has reached you.

You're also right to question the photo. I don't want to give you another explanation I can't stand behind, so I've asked the team to confirm where that stock really is.

I have now flagged this to the team as overdue. They have your shipment details, the receiving proof and your point about Waddinxveen. They need to either get the stock booked in and your parcel sent today, or get a power supply to you another way. A colleague is picking it up today and will reply to you in this thread.

Best regards, Sarah

---

Summary:
- **Where it stands:** Eric's replacement power supply (Shop····) is still on hold at the Dutch warehouse as out of stock. Nothing is reserved for it and there's no tracking, even though our Nov 10 email said the stock was received and would ship by end of week.
- **Flagged:** I raised a late_order flag asking the team to get the stock booked in and the parcel released today, or send a power supply another way.
- **Photo:** The flag also asks them to confirm the Waddinxveen location shown in the receiving photo. I couldn't verify where the warehouse is, so I made no claim about it to Eric.
- **Not offered:** No credit or code. That's for the team to decide.

Hi Eric,

That's great to hear, and thank you for letting us know. You shouldn't have had to wait two months for a power supply, and I'm sorry it took so long.

Since the miner is already running, you can ignore the earlier note about a follow-up on connecting it. Nothing more is needed from you.

If you ever want quick help or tips with the miner, our community on Discord is very active: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Happy mining, and thank you for your patience through all of this.

Best regards, Sarah

---

- **Status:** Eric has the replacement power supply and his BS-1 is mining, so his RMA is done. I didn't raise a flag, so the ticket should close on its own.
- **Hal's earlier promise:** Hal's previous reply said JD would answer Eric by email. My reply tells Eric he can ignore that, but if a hand-off to JD was opened, the team may want to close it.
- **Skipped:** I didn't ask for a Trustpilot review or ask the closing interview question. Eric only just got his miner running after a two-month wait, and his "finally" read as frustrated rather than happy.
